The Entra account of a row carried out before the identifier existed

entra_fill.Rd

Item 11 of the 0.27.0 (decided on 2026-11-12): the rows the channel carried out before applied_entra_id existed have none, and get it from the sweep, with a guard. The account that carries the username carried out now is the one served only if it was born before the row was first carried out under that name: since is the first seal of the newest run of executions of that name, report_person_since(), in Rome's civil time and to the minute as the log stamps it. The reference is the first seal of the run and not the last: with the last, a name given again and then an execution for a change of role would pass.

Usage

entra_fill(executed_username, directory, since, revoked = FALSE)

Arguments

executed_username

The username the row was carried out for.

directory

The sweep, as directory_users() returns it.

since

"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M" in Rome, as report_person_since() answers; character() or NA when the log does not say.

revoked

Whether the row asks for revoked.

Value

A list with id, the identifier to write or "", and code, TRASPORTO_NOME_RIASSEGNATO or "".

Details

  • Born before the end of that minute, createdDateTime read in UTC (report_graph_time()): the identifier is written, with no message.

  • Born after: on a row not revoked TRASPORTO_NOME_RIASSEGNATO and no identifier; on a revoked row neither.

  • A date that does not read, no since, nobody or two accounts carrying the name, an identifier the door would refuse: neither, and the next round tries again.

An account born in the same minute as the first seal passes: the log has minutes and Graph seconds, and a creation precedes the first execution by a round. An older account renamed onto the name freed by a deleted one passes too, the one case the guard does not see.
